messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads up — we need to lock the partner expectations + SLA & incentive framework for the private pilot kicking off Apr 6. Main things: recruitment criteria, engagement cadence, legal/data guardrails, and success metrics. Quick sync?
Samir Patel: I can do Wed 9am PT. can we produce a one-pager with asks beforehand?
Priya Rao: For research signal, I’d push for 10–12 partners. need a spread: 40% infra/platform, 60% product/feature teams. small teams preferred (3–8 ppl).
Liam O'Connor: From sales/SE side — +1 on 8–12. recommend reserved office hours (2x/week) and a dedicated Slack channel per partner. incentives: $2k credits + $300 Amazon/coffee stipend per team? keeps them engaged.
Elena Ruiz: Feedback cadence suggestion: weekly async checklists (Forms) + biweekly 30m 1:1s. deliverable per sprint: 3 prioritized issues and severity tags.
Ben Grey: Legal note: need NDA + DPA addendum for telemetry. turnaround for our standard template is ~5 business days once we get partner details. also confirm we’re not ingesting PII.
Maya Chen: good — we should define a minimal data sharing matrix. Priya, can you propose the telemetry fields we need vs optional?
Priya Rao: Will draft. minimal = model response, latencies, token counts, and a small set of example prompts (anonymized). optional = raw user inputs (only if partner opts in and we have DPA).
Samir Patel: Recruiting criteria draft: 1) active product roadmap using LLMs, 2) ability to commit 4–6 weeks, 3) L2 engineering contact, 4) willing to do 2 feedback sessions/week. any objections?
Liam O'Connor: Add: must have a test/dev environment to mirror production calls (to avoid noisy live data).
Elena Ruiz: UX ask: include a short onboarding checklist + expectations doc for partners. keep it one page.
Maya Chen: Incentive model decision: credits + small cash/offer. Does that align with finance? Samir to confirm cost model.
Samir Patel: I'll run numbers — estimate per-partner monthly cost ~ $2.5k incl credits + ops.
Ben Grey: Also need to lock retention period for logs (suggest 30 days by default, extendable by request).
Maya Chen: Success criteria (proposal): a) 8 partners completing 4-week pilot with >70% engagement on weekly tasks, b) measurable latency improvement or cost baseline established, c) 3 shipping product changes influenced by pilot feedback. thoughts?
Priya Rao: Add qualitative: partner NPS >= 7 and documented signal that model quality meets acceptance tests.
Liam O'Connor: Add commercial gate: at least 2 partners expressing intent to convert to paid Dedicated or Private within 30 days of pilot end.
Elena Ruiz: For exit criteria, clarify rollback path and support SLA for incidents during pilot. 24h ack, 72h mitigation plan.
Maya Chen: Action items: - Priya: telemetry & acceptance tests by Tue EOD. - Ben: NDA/DPA template + retention policy by end of week. - Samir: cost per partner + recruiting shortlist (12) by Thu. - Elena: 1-page onboarding doc + checklist by Thu. - Liam: draft partner outreach message and incentives by Thu.
pilot-bot: Meeting scheduled: Wed 09:00 PT · 30m (calendar invite sent). RSVP form: https://forms.example.com/privpilot-rsvp
Maya Chen: Thanks team — aiming to have final draft before Friday stakeholder review. If anyone has blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
